TEXT: After coming home from school that night, I received a mail on my phone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Title: Sorry for making you worry.
Is it from Saori? Let me see...
Eh... She says she'll be discharged tomorrow?
It's great that it wasn't anything bad!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Why are you all smiles, looking at your mail?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Uwah?! Don't look!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: There's no way that you have a girlfriend, so it's probably a mail from that black one or something, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Let me see what it's all about♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey! Don't peek!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...What is this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Saori was hospitalized?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Furthermore, you knew about it and kept silent up till now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-It's just some lightheadedness. It's not anything big.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I-I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But I didn't have any modeling work, so I could have visited her if you had told me...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Look, just calm down. She just didn't want to make you worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I-It has nothing to do with you...
Kirino isn't happy about this...
But I guess she can't be feeling good about being kept in the dark about her friend getting hospitalized.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't get so angry! Saori had her own circumstances...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...I don't care about her!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's that? You don't care? Aren't you two friends?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Friends... So what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: She might not think that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...She didn't tell me that she got hospitalized after all.
She has completely turned sulky... Although she's usually arrogant, she can be surprisingly delicate.
This is where Big Brother will come in and perk her up.
This is the time when I should provoke her, and since she's prideful, she'll definitely take the bait!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well then, I'll help her myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Because I'm her friend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...【Do whatever you want】.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah... What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're leaving? Aren't you going to help me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You're going to help her yourself, right? Then it has nothing to do with me!
Could it be that Kirino...
is super angry over the fact that she was kept in the dark about Saori's hospitalization?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What do you mean by "do whatever you want"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are you not Saori's friend?!
As I call out to her as she leaves, Kirino doesn't even look back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, so that's how it is. I get it, I get it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If that's how it is, I'll do whatever I want as you suggested.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...*sigh* C'mon, don't make me worry... geez...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kirino? Did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Nothing.
